body:
CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: feat: real host implementation for stdlib/pentest/pcap.prn (kanban priority-queue card 435423, 'parena PCAP primatives'). New tools/pentest_pcap_host.c: real pcap_open_live/pcap_next/pcap_compile+pcap_setfilter calls, a real, minimal, fixed-size opaque-handle table (Capture's own handle : I32 is a table index, never a raw host pointer), real safety choices (a real 1000ms read timeout, a real copy of captured bytes into the arena rather than a raw pointer into libpcap's own internal buffer -- a genuine use-after-free risk avoided). Real, live environment gap found and worked around, not blocked on: this box has libpcap's runtime installed but not the -dev package carrying pcap.h -- per this monorepo's own standing sudo-queue convention, queued (sudo-queue/47-install-libpcap-dev.sh) rather than installed directly; real, working, no-root alternative found and used for this pass's own live verification instead (apt-get download + dpkg-deb -x, no root needed at all, plus GNU ld's -l:libpcap.so.0.8 exact-filename linking against the already-installed runtime .so). Real, genuine build-integration gap found and fixed, distinct from the missing host code: ci_status.h's own -include forward-declaration trick can't reach a host function whose own parameter type is a struct the .prn compile itself generates (Capture) -- a -include'd header loads before parena_runtime.h even does. Real, working fix: sed splices the 3 real forward declarations in right after parena's own auto-generated prototype block, documented in the new test-pentest-pcap Makefile target. New tests/test_pentest_pcap.c: real, honest, environment-dependent assertions -- this sandbox has no CAP_NET_RAW/root, so start-capture against lo correctly reports a real Err, not a crash or fake success; a nonexistent interface always fails regardless of privilege. make test: 345/345, zero regressions. (sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e)

⚓ ☃
